notes.title: Early Access Release Pushed Back
notes.content:
[h1]Progress report: Stardate 02242019[/h1]

Worry not, interstellar beings - Tales From Galaxy 34 is still being developed! Here is an update log on recent developments.

Some pieces weren't coming together as fast I hoped so I'm pushing back the Early Access release date a bit. For now, we've chosen 2 more months of development just to be safe but I think it'll be much sooner. Here are some updates about recent additions.

[h1][u][b]Updated UI[/b][/u][/h1]
While the art is still in the process of being created, we have updated the user interface and will provide updated screenshots as soon as possible. 

[h1][u][b]New Missions[/b][/u][/h1]
Exploring the galaxy is an adventure in itself, but it wouldn’t be any fun unless you had some missions to complete, right? Ask and ye shall receive! 

[list]
[*] “Distress Signal” - Your crew receives a distress signal from a desperate crew - but what’s really going on? Their fate is in your hands, captain. What will you do?
[*] “Anomaly Detected” - Wormholes are, by their nature, bizarre. So, when a wormhole with unusual activity opens in front of your ship, you must decide what to do with it. You may find that not all is what it seems.
[*] “Big Floaty Thing” - There’s something big and floaty in front of your ship. Maybe there’s something special inside. Can you crack the code and unlock its hidden secrets? Or will you crack under pressure? Hurry, before it floats away!
[/list]

We will keep you guys updated as much as we can and we’re so excited for you to have the chance to play and explore this deep, rich universe. Until next time, space cadets! 

Wishlist the game to get updated when we're ready for everyone to explore Tales from Galaxy 34.
